author: Hamza A.
text: Turf is in great condition and the floodlights are proper. Booked the 9 PM slot, owner confirmed within minutes.

author: Bilal R.
text: Good ground, parking gets tight on weekends. Changing room could be cleaner but overall solid.

author: Usman K.
text: Best futsal surface in DHA. We play here every Tuesday now.

author: Ahmed S.
text: Decent pitch and easy to find. Water was available which is a plus in summer.

author: Zain M.
text: Owner is very cooperative, let us extend by 30 minutes when the next slot was free.

author: Faisal T.
text: Nets are well maintained, bowling machine available on request. Great for practice.
